title: perf(release): selectively attest constrained version-only bump commits
description:
Correct the bump/attest path so a release from fully-green main completes in seconds instead
of repeating the complete suite. Preserve fail-closed behavior for any unexpected release
diff and for a parent without complete qualifying attestation.
acceptance_criteria:
- The bump refuses unless its parent tree has fresh qualifying green evidence for every
  required attestation key.
- The accepted bump diff is limited to CHANGELOG.md, the project version in pyproject.toml,
  and the matching beadhive self-version in uv.lock; any other change fails closed.
- Version-only pyproject.toml and uv.lock changes do not invalidate code, unit, stateful,
  architecture, package, or license attestations; their green parent verdicts carry forward.
- Only changelog/release-metadata lint runs on the bump tree and finishes in seconds.
- Ordinary pyproject.toml or lockfile dependency changes still invalidate the appropriate
  attestations.
- docs/proof/bh-j5uyb.1-modularization-closeout.json is no longer rewritten by every bump,
  while its meaningful structural invariant remains checked.
- `just release` still waits for proof of the exact bump tree and atomically pushes main and
  the signed tag.
- Targeted release-flow tests cover fast carry-forward and all fail-closed cases.

dependencies.title: perf(release): carry green attestations across metadata-only version bumps
